# Eidoncore Comprehensive Platform Specification & LLM Knowledge Sheet

> Canonical URL: https://eidoncore.com/
> Description: Unified AI-native agency management platform, client portal system, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) workspace.

---

## 1. Executive Overview

Eidoncore is an operating system engineered specifically for digital agencies (design studios, software development agencies, marketing firms, creative consultancies, and independent creative practices). 

The primary problem Eidoncore solves is **agency software fragmentation**—where agencies pay multiple high-cost subscriptions (ClickUp/Asana for tasks, Harvest/Toggl for time tracking, Bonsai/PandaDoc for proposals, QuickBooks/Stripe for invoices, Zendesk/Freshdesk for tickets, Slack for internal chat, and Copilot/Kitchen for client portals), resulting in disjointed client experiences, siloed data, and per-seat subscription inflation.

Eidoncore unifies these tools into a single, cohesive interface powered by a PostgreSQL relational core, strict multi-tenant row-level isolation, and a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling direct orchestration by AI models such as Anthropic Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf.

---

## 2. Architecture & Technical Foundations

### Security & Privacy
- **Encryption**: AES-256 encryption at rest; TLS 1.3 encryption in transit.
- **Tenant Isolation**: Row-level database security guaranteeing strict boundary isolation between agency workspaces and client organizations.
- **Data Protection**: Full compliance with GDPR data protection requirements. Zero third-party behavioral analytics tracking; zero sale of user data.
- **Payment Processing**: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance via Stripe Connect. Eidoncore never stores raw credit card numbers or banking secrets.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Globally distributed edge infrastructure with automatic SSL certificate issuance and renewal via Let's Encrypt for all custom CNAME agency domains.

### Custom CNAME & White-Label Architecture
Agencies can point a custom DNS CNAME record (e.g., `portal.youragency.com`) to `cname.eidoncore.com`. Eidoncore automatically negotiates TLS certificates, replaces all Eidoncore branding with the agency's logo, color palette, custom favicon, and routes transactional emails through the agency's own custom SMTP provider (with SPF/DKIM validation).

---

## 3. Core Modules & Operational Workflows

### 3.1 AI Workspace & Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/ai-workspace/
- **Description**: A native Model Context Protocol server exposing 111+ tool calls to connected AI assistants.
- **Supported Assistants**: Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, and custom agentic frameworks.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Reading project statuses, health scores, and budget metrics.
  - Generating draft task breakdowns from client scopes.
  - Composing and adjusting proposals based on historical win rates.
  - Querying client communication logs and summarizing outstanding tickets.
  - Role-based permissions ensuring AI assistants cannot perform actions beyond their assigned token privileges.

### 3.2 Projects & Budget Burndown
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/projects/
- **Description**: Centralized project tracking with real-time budget diagnostics.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Milestone delivery timelines and Gantt-style dependencies.
  - Real-time financial budget burndowns comparing logged billable hours against quoted caps.
  - Account health scoring calculating stability, delivery velocity, and margin risk.
  - Internal vs. client-visible task flags preventing raw drafts from leaking to external clients.

### 3.3 Tasks & Kanban Boards
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/tasks/
- **Description**: High-velocity task board designed for agile agency teams.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Customizable Kanban columns (Backlog, Scoping, In Progress, Review, Blocked, Done).
  - Subtask checklists with individual assignments and due dates.
  - Live integrated stopwatch timers and manual time-entry logging.
  - Dense table views with bulk assignment, priority sorting, and tag filtering.

### 3.4 CRM & Client Relationship Engine
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/crm/
- **Description**: Relationship and deal pipeline tracking for high-ticket agency services.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Organization directories with primary contacts, technical leads, and billing owners.
  - Visual deal pipeline stages with weighted revenue forecasts.
  - Unified activity timeline capturing email conversations, phone notes, proposals sent, and ticket submissions.
  - Customer lifetime value (LTV) and historical profitability reporting.

### 3.5 Invoicing & Retainer Billing
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/invoicing/
- **Description**: Global billing engine tailored for recurring retainer and milestone agreements.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Recurring automated invoices charging saved client cards on the 1st or custom dates.
  - Milestone-based drawdowns for fixed-fee design and development projects.
  - Integrated Stripe Connect checkout supporting credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, and wire transfers.
  - Automated tax calculation, credit notes, refunds, and PDF receipt downloads.

### 3.6 Offerings & Productized Services
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/services/
- **Description**: Standardized service catalog enabling click-to-buy client purchasing.
- **Capabilities**:
  - 5 flexible pricing models: Fixed, Recurring Retainer, Hourly Drawdown, Tiered, and Milestone.
  - Self-serve purchasing inside the branded client portal.
  - Instant project auto-spinup: purchasing an offering automatically deploys the matching project template, assigns initial tasks, and delivers an intake form.

### 3.7 Proposals & Contracts
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/proposals/
- **Description**: Interactive proposals that eliminate static PDF friction.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Interactive pricing tables with optional upsell checkboxes (e.g., "Add 48hr rush delivery: +$1,200").
  - Legally binding digital e-signatures compliant with ESIGN and UETA.
  - Auto-generation of initial kickoff invoice upon signature.
  - Client view tracking and expiration timers.

### 3.8 Client Portal
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/portal/
- **Description**: Branded, white-label client experience under the agency's domain.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Deliverable review and approval workflows with revision feedback rounds.
  - Invoice payment history with one-click online settlements.
  - Secure file vault with download tracking.
  - Support ticket submission and real-time status updates.

### 3.9 Automations
- **Endpoint**: https://eidoncore.com/automations/
- **Description**: No-code visual rule engine eliminating manual agency overhead.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Triggers: Proposal signed, Invoice paid, Task completed, Intake form submitted, Ticket created.
  - Actions: Create project, deploy task board, send Slack alert, invite client, update CRM deal stage.
  - Webhooks: Inbound and outbound webhooks connecting Eidoncore with Zapier, Make, and internal APIs.

## 4. Plans, Pricing & Commercial Terms

- **Starter Plan**: $29/month ($24/month billed annually)
  - Up to 5 team members
  - 15 active projects
  - Branded client portal, basic invoicing, and task boards
- **Pro Plan**: $79/month ($64/month billed annually)
  - Up to 25 team members
  - Unlimited projects
  - Custom CNAME domain with automated SSL
  - Full AI Workspace with MCP server tools
  - Advanced recurring retainer billing and intake forms
- **Agency Plan**: $199/month ($159/month billed annually)
  - Unlimited team members (zero per-seat fees)
  - Unlimited active projects and client portals
  - Priority 24/7 SLA support
  - Custom webhook limits and dedicated account management
- **Trial Policy**: 14-day free Pro trial. No credit card required. No automatic lockouts.
